in_sanskrit.name: सानिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: सानिका (sānikā) is a Sanskrit name that means 'close companion', 'helper', or 'friend'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sāna', which means 'companion' or 'helper'. The suffix '-kā' means 'she who' or 'the one who'. Thus, Sanika is the name of a woman who is a close companion, helper, or friend.
